# Timeline UI

> Fixed-layout, themeable Vue 3 timeline component for AI agent transcripts. The host owns copy, icons and detail panels; the component owns the group header, row rail, disclosure mechanics and loading, ready and error detail shells.

- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@simon_he/timeline-ui
- Source: https://github.com/Simon-He95/timeline-ui
- Lab: https://timeline-ui.pages.dev/
- Docs: https://timeline-ui.pages.dev/?view=docs

## Core API

- TimelineGroup is the only public component.
- Props: group, expanded, expandedItemIds, lazyDetails, keepDetailsMounted.
- Events: update:expanded, update:expandedItemIds, detail-toggle, detail-retry, activate.
- Slot: summary with { group: TimelineGroupVM }.
- Theming: CSS variables on .timeline-ui, with data-tone="dark" as a preset.
